/images/ceh/m02-05-01-mail-journey-zh.sv:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 700" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0205-f1-zh-title m0205-f1-zh-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0205-f1-zh-title">圖 1｜郵件旅程與兩層地址</title>
<desc id="m0205-f1-zh-desc">信封地址用於投遞，信件標頭用於呈現；SMTP傳送，IMAP或HTTPS讀取。</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0205-f1-zh-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="698" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">圖 1｜郵件旅程與兩層地址</text>
<rect x="32" y="68" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="97" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">寄件者 → 郵件提交服務</text>
<text x="300" y="124" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">SMTP submission：提交這封信</text>
<text x="300" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">信件標頭：From / To</text>
<path d="M300 168V192" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0205-f1-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="196" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">寄件服務 → 中繼站</text>
<text x="300" y="252" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">SMTP：伺服器之間傳送</text>
<text x="300" y="279" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">信封：MAIL FROM / RCPT TO</text>
<path d="M300 296V320" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0205-f1-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="324" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="353" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">收件伺服器 → 信箱</text>
<text x="300" y="380" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">依信封收件地址投遞</text>
<text x="300" y="407" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">每個接收節點可加上 Received</text>
<path d="M300 424V448" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0205-f1-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="452" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="481" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">收件者開啟信箱</text>
<text x="300" y="508" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">IMAP：同步與讀信</text>
<text x="300" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">HTTPS：網頁信箱連線</text>
<text x="300" y="608" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">From / To 是信件內容的一部分</text>
<text x="300" y="634" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">MAIL FROM / RCPT TO 用於 SMTP 投遞</text>
</svg>
/images/ceh/m02-05-02-header-trust-zh.sv:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 700" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0205-f2-zh-title m0205-f2-zh-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0205-f2-zh-title">圖 2｜讀取時間線與信任來源</title>
<desc id="m0205-f2-zh-desc">Received新節點加在頂端；時間線由底往上，驗證由自家可信接收端向外。</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0205-f2-zh-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="698" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">圖 2｜讀取時間線與信任來源</text>
<rect x="32" y="68" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="97" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">頂端：較新的 Received</text>
<text x="300" y="124" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">自家可信收件服務新增</text>
<text x="300" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">先確認這個節點與驗證結果</text>
<rect x="32" y="196" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">信任邊界：由服務方界定</text>
<text x="300" y="252" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Authentication-Results 的可信來源</text>
<text x="300" y="279" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">以自家設定與日誌確認</text>
<rect x="32" y="324" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="353" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">下方：較早的 Received</text>
<text x="300" y="380" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">來自外部傳入的郵件內容</text>
<text x="300" y="407" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">逐段核對時間、節點及日誌</text>
<rect x="32" y="452" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="481" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">兩個閱讀方向</text>
<text x="300" y="508" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">時間順序：底部 ↑ 頂端</text>
<text x="300" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">信任驗證：自家接收端 → 外部</text>
<text x="300" y="608" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">圖中卡片用來對照欄位與判讀方向</text>
<text x="300" y="634" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">原始標頭保留欄位順序與完整內容</text>
</svg>
/images/ceh/m02-05-03-mail-authenticatio:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 700" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0205-f3-zh-title m0205-f3-zh-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0205-f3-zh-title">圖 3｜SPF、DKIM 與 DMARC</title>
<desc id="m0205-f3-zh-desc">SPF檢查信封網域的授權IP，DKIM驗證簽章，DMARC檢查From網域對齊。</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0205-f3-zh-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="698" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">圖 3｜SPF、DKIM 與 DMARC</text>
<rect x="32" y="68" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="97" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">SPF：寄送來源授權</text>
<text x="300" y="124" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">連線 IP ＋ MAIL FROM 網域</text>
<text x="300" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">依 DNS 政策檢查寄送來源</text>
<rect x="32" y="196" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">DKIM：網域簽章驗證</text>
<text x="300" y="252" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">d= 簽署網域 ＋ s= 選擇器</text>
<text x="300" y="279" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">驗證簽署涵蓋的標頭與本文</text>
<rect x="32" y="324" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="353" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">DMARC：與 From 網域對齊</text>
<text x="300" y="380" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">SPF 通過且對齊，或</text>
<text x="300" y="407" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">DKIM 通過且對齊</text>
<path d="M300 424V448" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0205-f3-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="452" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="481" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">接收端依政策處理</text>
<text x="300" y="508" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">none / quarantine / reject</text>
<text x="300" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">搭配服務方規則、過濾與日誌</text>
<text x="300" y="608" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">地址、簽章與內容判讀各有角色</text>
<text x="300" y="634" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">再核對信中要求、連結及業務情境</text>
</svg>
/images/ceh/m02-05-04-evidence-workflow-:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 700" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0205-f4-zh-title m0205-f4-zh-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0205-f4-zh-title">圖 4｜把郵件線索整理成證據</title>
<desc id="m0205-f4-zh-desc">在授權範圍內保存合成郵件、可信驗證結果與關聯日誌，分享時遮蔽個資。</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0205-f4-zh-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="698" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">圖 4｜把郵件線索整理成證據</text>
<rect x="32" y="68" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="97" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">保存原始郵件與來源</text>
<text x="300" y="124" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">合成案例：help@coffee.example</text>
<text x="300" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">記錄時間、時區與取得方式</text>
<path d="M300 168V192" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0205-f4-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="196" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">讀取可信接收端結果</text>
<text x="300" y="252" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Authentication-Results</text>
<text x="300" y="279" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">連同 Received 與網域一起判讀</text>
<path d="M300 296V320" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0205-f4-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="324" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="353" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">關聯郵件服務日誌</text>
<text x="300" y="380" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">比對時間、訊息識別與處理動作</text>
<text x="300" y="407" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">範例 IP：192.0.2.10</text>
<path d="M300 424V448" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0205-f4-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="452" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="481" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">整理結論與下一步</text>
<text x="300" y="508" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">保留原件，分享副本遮蔽個資</text>
<text x="300" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">以證據說明觀察到的流程</text>
<text x="300" y="608" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">本圖全部使用合成資料</text>
<text x="300" y="634" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">測試與查核依明確授權範圍進行</text>
</svg>
/images/ceh/m02-05-01-mail-journey-en.sv:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 700" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0205-f1-en-title m0205-f1-en-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0205-f1-en-title">1 | Mail journey and two address layers</title>
<desc id="m0205-f1-en-desc">Envelope addresses route mail; message headers present it. SMTP sends; IMAP or HTTPS reads.</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0205-f1-en-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="698" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">1 | Mail journey and two address layers</text>
<rect x="32" y="68" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="97" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Sender → submission service</text>
<text x="300" y="124" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">SMTP submission sends the message</text>
<text x="300" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Message headers: From / To</text>
<path d="M300 168V192" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0205-f1-en-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="196" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Sending service → relay</text>
<text x="300" y="252" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">SMTP transfers mail between servers</text>
<text x="300" y="279" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Envelope: MAIL FROM / RCPT TO</text>
<path d="M300 296V320" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0205-f1-en-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="324" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="353" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Receiving server → mailbox</text>
<text x="300" y="380" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Deliver to the envelope recipient</text>
<text x="300" y="407" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Receiving hops add Received fields</text>
<path d="M300 424V448" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0205-f1-en-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="452" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="481" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Recipient opens the mailbox</text>
<text x="300" y="508" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">IMAP: mailbox access and sync</text>
<text x="300" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">HTTPS: webmail connection</text>
<text x="300" y="608" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">From / To belong to the message</text>
<text x="300" y="634" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">MAIL FROM / RCPT TO guide SMTP delivery</text>
</svg>
/images/ceh/m02-05-02-header-trust-en.sv:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 700" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0205-f2-en-title m0205-f2-en-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0205-f2-en-title">2 | Read the timeline and trusted origin</title>
<desc id="m0205-f2-en-desc">New Received entries are prepended. Read the timeline upward; validate outward from a trusted receiver.</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0205-f2-en-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="698" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">2 | Read the timeline and trusted origin</text>
<rect x="32" y="68" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="97" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Top: newer Received entry</text>
<text x="300" y="124" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Added by your trusted receiving service</text>
<text x="300" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Start with this hop and its results</text>
